summary: Following the recent midterm elections, statehood advocates say they see renewed momentum for DC's admission as a state. Meanwhile, DC Vote has documented nine recent attacks on DC's local authority and outlined the current status of the statehood campaign, while also highlighting that the District's population already exceeds that of some existing states. Without statehood, Congress reviews the District's laws and can vote to repeal them.
